name: Hotel Sayaji Kolhapur
why_special: Sayaji Hotels' 5-star Kolhapur flagship 5 km from city centre — outdoor pool, multi-cuisine Kebabsta and Habibi (Lebanese). The polished 5-star anchor for Mahalaxmi Temple pilgrim families and Panhala Fort visitors, with the strongest spa in town.

name: Hotel Pearl Kolhapur
location: Sykes Extension, near New Mahadwar Road
why_special: Kolhapur's senior 3-star walking-distance from Mahalaxmi Temple — 60 rooms, Maharashtrian/non-veg restaurant Mahabhog, the local pick for pilgrim families that want temple-proximity over highway 5-stars.

name: Hotel Tulsi Kolhapur
why_special: Mid-range 3-star opposite Kolhapur railway station — 56 rooms, vegetarian restaurant, the reliable pick for overnight train arrivals continuing to Panhala or Jyotiba. Walking-distance to Mahalaxmi Temple (1.5 km).
